breakfast.custom_shake: Protein Shake Template. BASE (REQUIRED, FIXED — never scale these to hit budget): 45g protein powder (1.5 scoops), 5g creatine, 300g water. DYNAMIC INGREDIENT SELECTION (choose 2-4 items to meet target; if the fixed base doesn't cover the protein budget, one of them MUST be a Protein Boost item — never raise the 45g protein powder to compensate): Fruits (100g frozen mixed berries, frozen mango, frozen cherries), Carbs (15g barley max, 15g oats), Protein Boost (80g yoghurt, cottage cheese, milk, silken tofu), Nuts (20g almonds, 20g walnuts), Seeds (3g flaxseeds, 4g chia seeds, 3g hemp seeds), Greens/Vege (30g spinach, 50g frozen raw broccoli, 50g frozen raw cauliflower), Flavor/Spice (cocoa powder, ginger, mustard seeds, turmeric).
breakfast.eggs_salmon: Scrambled eggs and smoked salmon served on toasted whole-grain bread.
breakfast.fish_pate: Tinned sardines or tinned mackerel pate served on toasted whole-grain bread.
breakfast.beans_toast: Classic baked beans served on toasted whole-grain bread.
breakfast.yoghurt_bowl: Yoghurt Bowl. BASE: 120g yoghurt. SEEDS: 3g flaxseeds, 4g chia seeds, 3g hemp seeds, 5g pumpkin seeds. FRUIT: 20g fresh blueberries, 20g fresh strawberries. NUTS: 20g almonds, 20g walnuts.

mediterranean_diet.label: Mediterranean Diet
mediterranean_diet.principles: Favor olive oil, oily fish, legumes, whole grains and vegetables; limit red meat and butter to occasional use.

fast_800.label: Fast 800
fast_800.principles: Keep dishes simple and calorie-light within the given budget: lean protein and vegetables first, minimal added fat, sauce or oil, and no refined carbs padding the plate.

dash.label: DASH Diet
dash.principles: Favor vegetables, fruit, low-fat dairy and whole grains; minimize added salt and sodium-heavy ingredients such as cured meats, brined or canned-in-salt items, and salty condiments.

total_wellbeing_diet.label: Total Wellbeing Diet
total_wellbeing_diet.principles: High protein with moderate low-GI carbs, lean meat or dairy at most meals, and strict portion discipline — no incidental extras beyond what the budget calls for.

mind_diet.label: MIND Diet
mind_diet.principles: Include leafy greens daily and berries at least twice a week; favor walnuts, olive oil, poultry and fish; strictly limit cheese, butter, fried food and pastries.

nordic_diet.label: Nordic Diet
nordic_diet.principles: Favor fatty cold-water fish (mackerel, salmon, herring), root vegetables, cruciferous vegetables and berries, dressed in cold-pressed rapeseed or flaxseed oil rather than tropical oils or butter.

blue_zones.label: Blue Zones / Longevity
blue_zones.principles: Build the plate almost entirely from whole plants — legumes, beans, nuts, seeds, wild herbs and extra virgin olive oil — with wild-caught fish only 2-3 times a week and meat rare to never.

anti_inflammatory.label: Anti-Inflammatory
anti_inflammatory.principles: Load meals with polyphenol-rich vegetables, cruciferous greens, wild fatty fish and therapeutic spices and aromatics (turmeric, ginger, garlic); avoid refined seed oils and refined carbohydrates.

paleo.label: Paleo
paleo.principles: Build meals from pastured meat, seafood, eggs, fibrous vegetables, root vegetables, fruit and nuts; exclude all grains, legumes, refined sugar and standard dairy.

pegan.label: Pegan
pegan.principles: Give non-starchy, low-glycemic vegetables and healthy fats (avocado, nuts, seeds, olive oil) roughly three-quarters of the plate, with clean animal protein as a smaller side rather than the centerpiece.

low_fodmap.label: Low-FODMAP
low_fodmap.principles: Avoid high-FODMAP ingredients — onion, garlic, wheat, most legumes, high-fructose fruit — substituting garlic-infused oil, scallion or spring-onion greens, fresh ginger and chives, and favor gut-friendly produce like zucchini, bok choy and carrots.

aip.label: Autoimmune Protocol (AIP)
aip.principles: Exclude grains, legumes, nightshades (tomato, pepper, eggplant, potato), dairy, eggs and seed-based spices; build meals from organ meats, clean proteins, bone broth and non-nightshade vegetables.
